ja258:1.1: As far as moon and sun revolve in the directions, shining, radiant,
ja258:1.4: those whose breath depends upon earth.
ja258:2.1: Not through a rain of coins is satisfaction found in sense desires,
ja258:2.3: The wise one knowing sense pleasures have little joy, (much) suffering.
ja258:3.1: But he does not find delight in divine pleasures, the disciple
ja258:3.3: Of the Perfect Sambuddha finds delight in craving’s destruction.
